description.narrative: The project will help the Government of the Philippines boost local government revenue mobilization to improve local public service delivery and strengthen local governance. The focus will be on improvements to the administration of the real property tax (RPT) and on management reforms.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3944: 31% of contracts awarded and 16% disbursed as of 20 Feb 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Outcome a: 1,619 local government units meet the target. Average FYs 2021-2023: 94.38%Outcome b: Php331.093 billion collection as of FY 2023 year-end representing 60.73% increase from FY2017 collections.Source: BLGF Statement of Receipts and Expenditure.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52173/52173-002-apfs-en_1.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Republic Act 12001 known as the Real Property Valuation and Assessment Reform Act (RPVARA) was signed into law by the President on 13 Jun 2024, authorizing the creation of the Real Property Valuation service which covers the expanded functions of the BLGF. The implementing rules and regulations of the RPVARA was drafted and submitted to DOF on 17 Sep with the final version expected to be submitted by October 2024.Out of the targeted 4 updated manuals, the local assessment manual (LAM), formerly the manual on real property appraisal and assessment operations (MRPAAO) and the Philippine Valuation Standards will be ready in time for the soft launching in Oct 2024 while the remaining manuals (Mass Appraisal Guidebook, RPTCIS, and Assessment, Evaluation, Examination Monitoring Manual) are aimed to be finalized by Dec 2024.Status as of 30 September 2024: Evaluation of technical and financial proposals from the 5 firms for RPIS will be conducted after the submission deadline on 21 Oct 2024.Status as of 30 September 2024: Evaluation of technical and financial proposals from the 7 firms for CAMA and GIS Technology due after the deadline for submission on 21 Oct 2024.Of the 20 pilot LGUs, 8 have completed general revision, with 2 almost for completion and 3 ongoing general revision; while 7 LGUs are still waiting for the approval of their SMV.Of the 20 participating LGUs, 14 with completed Revenue Compliance Study report, 4 are ongoing and 2 with no submission yet. Additionally, 15 LGus have completed the Impact Study Report with 2 ongoing and 3 with no submission yet.Status as of 30 September 2024: A total of 340 or 49.93% female assessors training out of 791.Status as of 30 September 2024: For the e-learning platform system, scripts for the 7 modules of SMV developed and for pilot testing scheduled on 29 Oct 2024.
